items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The helper `_filter_prefetch_queryset` has a clear name and readable steps (`predicate`, `low_mark`, `high_mark`, `window`), and its formatting matches the file. It has no docstring, which is a minor gap.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The helper is short and reuses ORM pieces (Window, RowNumber, lookups, clear_limits). But only the reverse-FK path calls it; the M2M get_prefetch_queryset still uses its own `__in` filter. It also sits awkwardly between descriptor classes.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The code raises `NotSupportedError` when the backend lacks window functions, but `NotSupportedError` is never imported (only `DEFAULT_DB_ALIAS, connections, router, transaction` were added). On such backends users get a NameError instead of the intended message.

items.name: Per-parent slice semantics for open/bounded slices
items.name_zh: 开放/有界切片按父对象分区
items.evidence: The reverse-FK path slices per parent correctly in SQL (Window partitioned by the field, GreaterThan/LessThanOrEqual, high_mark None handled). The M2M path was left unchanged, so sliced M2M prefetches still raise. The hidden tests test_m2m_forward, test_m2m_reverse and test_reverse_ordering fail.
